Options and environment variables

Usage:
  help-values [flags]

Flags:
      --port int            Listening port. (default 8080)
      --multiplier float    Retry delay multiplier. (default 1.5)
      --tags strings        Tags; repeat the flag for each value. (default ["web", "background worker"])
      --level string        Logging level. (default Info)
      --db json             Database settings as JSON. (default { host: "localhost", port: 5432 })
  -h, --help                help for help-values

Environment variables:
  HELP_API_TOKEN string  API token supplied through the environment. (required)
